children: INCREASES ITS STAKE IN TERÉGA BY 18% TO 49.5% OF ITS SHARE CAPITAL
DEAL FOR A TOTAL OF 311 MILLION EUROS
TRANSACTION IS EXPECTED TO CLOSE BEFORE END OF 2026
STAKE WILL CONTINUE TO BE ACCOUNTED FOR USING THE EQUITY METHOD

18% STAKE ACQUIRED FROM EDF INVEST, A DIVISION OF ELECTRICITÉ DE FRANCE SA (EDF)
